purpose: Check that the hosted Boltz-2 integration reproduces a known antibody-antigen crystal complex end to end. Not a discovery and not a generalization test.

target.title: HyHEL-10 Fab - hen egg white lysozyme complex

comparison_to_crystal.method: CA-only, residue-aligned; interface pair = antibody-antigen CA-CA distance < 8 A; scoring script: scripts/score_complex_against_crystal.py

limitations: 3HFM is an old, public structure and is very likely in Boltz-2's training data, so close agreement is expected and does not show generalization to unseen antibodies.
Single complex, single sample, single seed; no uncertainty estimate.
CA-only metrics and a crude contact definition; not DockQ and not an affinity or developability assessment.
The model's own confidence (0.94) agrees with the measured accuracy here, but one agreeing case does not calibrate it.
next: Repeat on antibody-antigen complexes released after the model's training cutoff and report the distribution, including failures.
